product.title: Sunset Cruise in Los Cabos with Jazz and Wine

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, the Tropicat jazz-and-wine sunset cruise boards an elegant catamaran for Lover's Beach, Land's End, and the Arch with an open international bar. Gourmet meats, cheeses, and crudités are served with premium wines so the evening stays on deck. Hotel transfers from most Los Cabos properties must be reserved at least 48 hours ahead. In season the crew also watches for whales while the published route stays on the rock formations at Land's End. The format suits visitors who want a guided wine-focused sail without booking a private charter. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the marina, Lover's Beach, and Arch that shape this jazz cruise rather than a tequila-ranch add-on.

highlights: Listen to smooth jazz while sampling canapés and wine aboard the Tropicat, an elegant catamaran
This jazz cruise departs Cabo San Lucas in the early evening and features an open international bar
Glide into the sunset while you pass landmarks such as Lover's Beach and the Arch at Land's End
